name: popup-menu-dark-theme
title: 播放控制下拉菜单(PopupMenu)统一暗色主题
creator: M0e_N00b
notes: DONE 2026-10-02 in cea16e6 (build-windows-debug.ps1 BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 172 unit tests, debug resources compiled). Took the PRD's option 1 (theme override) rather than option 2 (migrate to Compose DropdownMenu), because these 7 menus are triggered by View-system buttons from controls.xml and migrating them would change the trigger structure the PRD says to leave alone. Root cause: both Activities use a bare android:Theme (Theme.Transparent) with no popupMenuStyle, so unwrapped PopupMenu fell back to the platform default light popup. Added Theme.ViriViri.DarkPopup + Widget.ViriViri.DarkPopupMenu with colours mirroring CinemaPalette.DARK in the new res/values/colors.xml, and routed all 7 sites through one darkPopupMenu(anchor) helper wrapping the context with ContextThemeWrapper. Only the context theme changed: item order, ids, checkable groups and click handling are untouched. STILL OPEN (device): per-menu visual confirmation that all 7 menus (volume / quality / speed / display ratio / canvas size / debug target / debug plan) read consistently dark with legible text and checked state.
